archimate:ApplicationProcess.documentation:
a logical process to capture what the Bank does
Economic capital, curve modelling and other advanced risk models will remain outside the platform making data integration as important as platform functionality. Fund Management's Transaction Assessment Models will continue to support pricing and underwriting, Economic Capital, IFRS 9 stress testing, and PD/LGD modelling will remain the responsibility of the Risk Modelling team.
